QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_36

question.text: Under the SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) Amendment Regulations 2023, an AIF Manager is required to redress an investor grievance within:

answer.text: 21 calendar days from the date of receipt of the grievance

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that AIF Managers must redress investor grievances within 21 calendar days from the date of receipt, and that complaints filed on SCORES are routed to the AIF for an Action Taken Report within the same timeframe. The Trap: 7 calendar days is too short relative to the source-stated TAT. 60 and 90 calendar days are not the figures used in the workbook for AIF grievance redressal. Note: The workbook states the 21-calendar-day requirement on page 242; it does not prescribe an internal SOP or grading methodology.
